name: THE FIZZ Munich
about:
The FIZZ Munich is a stylish student accommodation in Munich, offering furnished Flex and Single apartments. In less than 15 minutes you can reach the Technical University of Munich (TUM) and Ludwig Maximilian University (LMU) by bike. Only 10 minutes away is the hip nightlife district Maxvorstadt. The all-in price covers all the utility bills, necessities, and services. The generously dimensioned community areas in The FIZZ Munich include a gaming room & lounge area, community kitchens, a rooftop terrace, a study room, a co-working space, and more. Experienced and friendly staff provide residents with professional and considerate service. The rental period is highly flexible, allowing you to choose between long-term or short-term leases, ranging from one to six months. In a word, The FIZZ Munich creates a comfortable and safe living experience for you.The FIZZ Munich FeaturesRoom Features
The FIZZ Munich provides two types of student apartments: Flex and Single, ranging from 16 to 40 square meters, perfectly balancing privacy with premium quality. Each studio is student-centered designed and well-equipped with a comfortable double bed, working area, kitchenette, bathroom, and generous storage space. The Flex Studios feature bespoke extras, including a full cutlery/crockery set, a coffee machine, and a smart TV. Select premium studios even boast a private balcony or terrace. Enjoy complete privacy with your own en-suite bathroom. Your room also features a private kitchenette complete with a double ceramic hob, microwave, and fridge-freezer. Some layouts even offer an optional dishwasher. Community Amenities
The FIZZ Munich has been committed to improving the living experience of residents. The communal areas provide additional space for networking, learning and relaxing. What you can expect at The FIZZ Munich:Bill-inclusive rentHigh-speed internetCommunity kitchensRooftop terraceGaming roomLounge areaStudy roomCo-working space and loungeParking spacesBike parkingEvents: regularly organized, such as a cooking or movie night, a workshop, a yoga class or a lectureSecurity & Services
The building is highly secure with 24/7 CCTV and night/weekend security patrols. Students also benefit from a dedicated parcel acceptance service, an on-site communal laundry room, secure bicycle storage, and available underground/outdoor car parking.First aid and fire protectionRental articles: You can borrow household items for free, such as a vacuum cleaner, iron and ironing board, PlayStation, board games, and more.Events and activities are regularly organized, such as a cooking or movie night, a workshop, a yoga class, a lecture, etc. Plenty of opportunities to meet new friends.Location & What's Hot Nearby?
THE FIZZ Munich is located in the Neuhausen-Nymphenburg district, just a few minutes' walking distance from the Olympic Park and many shopping malls. So your stay in Munich will be very colorful, with many activities available throughout the year. Also, you're surrounded by numerous restaurants, bars, cafes and trendy clubs living in THE FIZZ Munich:Universities:
TU Munich (TUM): Approximately 3.3 km away. Cycle there in just 14 minutes, or hop on a tram/bus to reach the main campus in about 20-25 minutes.LMU Munich: Approximately 4 km away. A 17-minute cycle or a 25-30 minute journey via public transport gets you to your morning lectures with ease.Restaurants: Neuhauser Augustiner (Bavarian restaurant, 650m, 9min walking), Ristorante ROMANS (Italian restaurant, 1km, 14min walking), P.Korn Restaurant & Steaks (steak house, 1.7km, 24min walking), Restaurant Poseidon (Greek restaurant, 1.1km, 14min walking)Coffee: The Tribeca Cafe (750m 10min walking), Alps Coffee - Espresso Bar (800m, 11min walking), Leons Backhaus (1km, 14min walking)Pubs & Bars: Pilsquelle Neuherz Ana (500m, 7min walking), HideOut Bar (1km, 13min walking), Taubenschlag Bar (1.6km, 22min walking)Supermarkets: EDEKA & PENNY are both major German supermarket chains are within a 10-13 minute walk, offering a massive selection of fresh produce and daily essentials. Express Supermarket is just a 6-minute walk (450m) away—perfect for grabbing snacks or last-minute groceries. Park: Olympiapark is only minutes away by foot or bike. this massive green oasis is Munich's most popular spot for a morning run, a scenic walk, or open-air summer concerts. Hotspots: Nymphenburg Palace is a quick 10-minute cycle (approx. 2.7 km) away, bringing you to the breathtaking summer palace of the Bavarian kings and its stunning swan lakes. Cycle 10 minutes to reach Munich's trendiest district, Maxvorstadt, packed with bustling pubs, bars, and clubs.Transport
The transportation near THE FIZZ Munich is very convenient. Just walk a few minutes and you'll reach transit stops and take buses, S-Bahn, U-Bahn and easily get around.
Trams & Buses:
The building is surrounded by convenient transit stops. Walk just a few minutes to reach Volkartstraße Ost, Albrechtstraße, Fasaneriestraße, or Leonrodplatz, where you can catch trams and buses that seamlessly connect to the city's U-Bahn (underground) and S-Bahn (overground) networks.
Central Station & Airport:Munich Central Station (München Hbf): Reach the main railway station in 15-20 minutes via local tram or bus routes, making travel across Germany and Europe incredibly easy.Munich Airport (MUC): From the Central Station, simply catch the S1 or S8 S-Bahn line to reach the airport terminals in 45-50 minutes—perfect for international students flying home for the holidays.
